name: nijin
about: the grid of nijin, added once the pilot (hpnP, code/nijin_pilot.py) has set its orders

parts.about: the grid 0.15-12.510 g at 0.004 g in van der Corput order (coarse to fine: 0.02 g after a fifth of it), at 80 digits, the 16 pumps of the pilot left out; the orders by range of P as the pilot set them for the lines narrower than 6 g (code/nijin_pilot.py --gmax 6): B (150w, 200) on 0-2.004, D (150w, 250, 300) on 2.004-; 3075 pumps, 5898 kh
